title: Provider interface
description: What the loop (C1) sends to a provider (C2) and what it gets back. The provider is stateless; the prompt is passed in full every call.

messages.description: The session transcript (C4), compacted to the window: goals plus assistant/observation entries. The goal and plan are pinned in the system prompt.

tools.description: Tool definitions advertised to the model (C3).

providerResponse.description: The parsed completion: a thought and the chosen action. A completion with no parseable action is returned as a finish (C2).
